name: tyro-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is tyro, a Python library that builds command-line interfaces from
type-annotated functions, dataclasses and other structures: it turns parameters and fields into
arguments, flags, positional arguments and subcommands, parses them with its own backend, generates
helptext from docstrings, comments and annotations, and offers configuration markers, custom
constructors and other helper utilities.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the tyro package under src/tyro/ (except src/tyro/_backends/_argparse.py, a vendored copy of the standard library's argparse), together with README.md, docs/source/index.md, docs/source/your_first_cli.md, docs/source/whats_supported.rst, docs/source/helptext_generation.rst, docs/source/tab_completion.md, every page under docs/source/examples/ except pytorch_jax.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.12 with tyro's dependencies and t
